newsitem.title: USA: Market Facts sees profit, revenue gains.
newsitem.headline: Market Facts sees profit, revenue gains.

text.p: Market Facts Inc, a market research and information company, said Friday it expects its earnings growth to exceed its revenue growth in 1997.

"We believe that our increase in revenue in 1997 will continue to outpace our industry, and that our earnings growth will exceed our revenue growth," said Tom Payne, president and chief executive officer, in a statement.

Earlier today, Market Facts reported its 1997 first quarter earnings rose 58 percent from the same period a year ago to $835,000 and earnings per share rose 64 percent to $0.23. Revenue for the quarter advanced 16 percent from last year to $21.6 million.
